summary: Claude Code classified the ambiguous "make form validation reusable" brief as architectural, ran the full brainstorming question/approach/design flow, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for review, and only began writing-plans (no code) after my "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are satisfied by direct observation of the screen transcript, the session JSONL log (skill invocation), and the filesystem (spec file present, no source files modified before approval). The only anomalies are the stubbed Codex review returning empty verdicts and the spec being gitignored, neither of which is part of the criteria.

observations.description: The Codex review companion gate degraded: screen reported "both exited 0 but wrote an empty {} payload", "verdict-normalize --require-coverage returned incomplete for both: 'json payload has no terminal verdict'", runtime "codex-plugin-cc 0.0.0-stub", no config.toml at $CODEX_HOME. The agent handled it honestly (ungated-ledger event 20260917T025645Z-60641-14761) but the independent review never happened at either the approach or spec gate.

The agent created a .gitignore covering docs/hyperpowers so the spec is deliberately untracked (`git status --short` shows only `?? .gitignore`). The spec exists on disk but is never committable — this may conflict with expectations of a 'committed spec file'.

The multi-select question widget requires arrowing past 4-5 options to reach 'Submit'; with an option pre-recommended and checkbox toggling, it's easy to accidentally toggle rather than submit. Minor friction in a keyboard-only TUI.
Spec header says 'Status: approved in brainstorming, pending user review of this document' — slightly confusing wording, since approval had not yet been given at write time.

criteria.evidence: Session log grep: `grep -o '"name":"Skill","input":{[^}]*}' <session>.jsonl` returned `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}` (and later writing-plans).

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Classification: architectural. This looks small, but the repo has exactly one form ... so I'll run the full process: questions → approaches → design → written spec". File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-reusable-form-validation-design.md (ls -R docs).

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review and approval before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-reusable-form-validation-design.md ... Please review it and tell me if you want changes. Once you approve, the next step is the writing-plans skill ... no code before then." `git status --short` in the workdir showed only `?? .gitignore` — app.js/index.html untouched.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Agent explicitly said "Classification: architectural" and produced a spec file; no in-chat-only bounded design was offered.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language on screen; the flow was questions → approaches (A/B/C with recommendation) → sectioned design → spec document.
